{
  "project_id": "P-BGD-SocialProtectionResilience",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Economic uncertainty and lingering impacts from the August 2024 political transition could delay project execution and structural reforms.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage proactively with interim government leadership, establish clear inter-ministerial coordination mechanisms, and prioritize technical implementation milestones.",
      "evidence": "lingering economic impact of the recent political transition"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High inflation rates risk eroding the real value and purchasing power of monthly cash transfer benefits provided to poor households.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and adopt a standardized benefits adequacy framework and indexation mechanism under Subcomponent 2.1 to inform periodic budget adjustments.",
      "evidence": "the real value of benefits under the DSS’s Old Age Allowance and Widow Allowance programs has decreased since 2016"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Recurring severe floods and extreme climate events could inundate project areas and disrupt livelihoods, increasing safety net demand.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Integrate dynamic climate-shock targeting into the Dynamic Social Registry, prioritize climate-vulnerable locations, and maintain an active Contingent Emergency Response Component.",
      "evidence": "recurring flooding affects a greater share of the population than any other natural hazard"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "High baseline inclusion and exclusion errors in safety net programs cause significant misallocation of cash transfer resources.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish and roll out the Dynamic Social Registry using standardized proxy means testing scores and digitized data verification.",
      "evidence": "The inclusion and exclusion errors are approximately 60 percent"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Institutional weaknesses and cross-ministry coordination failures that hampered past social registry efforts (such as NHD) could recur.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor overall DSR coordination in the Finance Division, establish Cabinet-backed steering oversight, and formalize inter-agency roles via MoUs.",
      "evidence": "Past efforts to create a social registry through the National Household Database (NHD) did not materialize"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Complex financial management across multiple implementing agencies and varied expenditure types creates risk of accounting delays or non-compliance.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit certified FM consultants at both PIUs, integrate iBAS++ tracking, submit quarterly IUFRs, and execute annual risk-based internal audits.",
      "evidence": "From the FM perspective, the project design is complex due to the intricacy of activity selection and various IAs and finances"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Fiscal pressure or revenue collection shortfalls could jeopardize the timely provision of the government's substantial counterpart funding.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Structure PBC disbursements against regular national safety net allowance budget lines (economic code 3721) to lock in funding flows.",
      "evidence": "Counterpart Funding Borrower/Recipient 3,848.00"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Centralized storage and processing of national identity numbers and socioeconomic data pose data security, privacy, and cyber risks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Host registry systems in secure National Data Centers equipped with disaster recovery facilities and adhere strictly to national data security regulations.",
      "evidence": "the design of the DSR and module development will contain clear mitigation measures to address data security risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Gender disparities in digital skills and financial literacy could restrict female access to G2P digital payments and DSR registration.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Design simplified user interfaces and local language audio guides, deploy female frontline staff, and provide targeted financial literacy training.",
      "evidence": "Women report limited digital and financial access, which constrains their access to G2P payments"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Lack of administrative and MIS integration across the four DSS livelihoods programs prevents seamless case management and beneficiary graduation.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Harmonize the DSS livelihoods program MIS, establish interoperability with the DSR, and dedicate specialized PIU staff to program coordination.",
      "evidence": "there is limited integration within these programs in terms of administrative systems, data/information, and resource management."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Sub-grants transferred directly to local social club bank accounts risk delayed expenditure reporting or fiduciary mismanagement.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Mandate official club enlistment, require dual-signatory bank accounts, enforce monthly countersigned SOE reporting, and record funds as advances until reconciled.",
      "evidence": "Grants to social clubs under Subcomponent 2.2 will be financed through the DSS’s DA and transferred directly"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Severe seasonal flooding in disaster-prone Upazilas could prevent program participants from attending in-person livelihoods training.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate e-learning options into the training curriculum and disburse training stipends via direct electronic fund transfers.",
      "evidence": "risk of intense floodings in the region, which may restrict in-person attendance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Frontline social service officers and field cadres may lack the operational capacity to manage modernized DSR workflows and business processes.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deliver continuous central and field-level training programs to ensure at least one fully trained personnel and active DSR access point in every Upazila.",
      "evidence": "Each Upazila in the country has at least one DSS personnel who has been trained on the updated business processes"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Failure to establish implementation units, steering committees, or the Project Operations Manual within strict legal deadlines could delay effectiveness.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Assign experienced staff from predecessor projects, advance-draft the POM, and systematically track legal covenant timeline compliance.",
      "evidence": "establish within six (6) months of the Effective Date... the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) at the DSS"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays or reluctance by partnering line ministries in executing MoUs could impede onboarding non-DSS cash transfer programs to the DSR.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Leverage the Cabinet Division-led DSR Steering Committee to facilitate inter-agency dialogue and resolve policy disputes swiftly.",
      "evidence": "MoWCA is expected to sign a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the FD and DSS"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Ad hoc training quality and limited market relevance in existing livelihoods schemes risk failing to secure long-term employment for beneficiaries.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Overhaul training curricula with technical, life skills, and financial modules, conduct market assessment studies, and offer post-training mentorship.",
      "evidence": "training components, they are often ad hoc and limited in coverage and depth"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Procedural delays in finalizing CERC manuals and emergency action plans could hinder rapid disbursement during a major crisis.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Draft and formally adopt the CERC Manual and Emergency Action Plan early during standard project implementation.",
      "evidence": "adopted the CERC Manual and Emergency Action Plan, in form and substance acceptable to the Association."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Foreign exchange reserve volatility and currency depreciation could exacerbate national macroeconomic vulnerability and import capacity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain close alignment with international development partner financing and leverage public financial management strengthening efforts.",
      "evidence": "FX reserves stood at US$19.9 billion (approximately 3.3 months of prospective imports)."
    }
  ]
}
